usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/modal/sandbox/create with JSON body {} (optional config fields like image, timeout, cpu, memory)
usage.outputShape: body.sandbox_id (the handle for follow-up calls), body.status (e.g. "running"), body.config.{image,timeout,cpu,memory,gpu}
quirks: Empty JSON body {} is accepted — backend applies defaults: image python:3.11, timeout 300s, cpu 1, memory 512MB, gpu null
Returns synchronously with status already 'running' (no polling needed for create)
sandbox_id (e.g. sb-...) is the session handle you must pass to companion endpoints (execute/status/terminate) — create is step 1 of a multi-step sandbox lifecycle
Charges $0.010 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per create; the sandbox has a 300s default timeout so terminate or reuse promptly
usage.guide: POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/modal/sandbox/create with an empty JSON body {} (x402 pays $0.01 USDC on Base automatically). The response is synchronous JSON: read body.sandbox_id and keep it — it is the handle you pass to the execute/status/terminate endpoints in the same sandbox service. body.status will already be "running" and body.config shows the applied defaults (python:3.11, 300s, 1 cpu, 512MB). To customize, send config fields in the body; otherwise defaults apply. The sandbox auto-expires after its timeout, so run your code and terminate (or let it expire) promptly.
